## What would you like to improve?

Describe the feature or improvement clearly.

## Why is it useful?

Explain the user, recruiter, developer, or accessibility benefit.

## Suggested approach

Share any implementation idea, reference, or example.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] The change supports the portfolio's developer-focused goals
- [ ] The expected user experience is clear
- [ ] The change can be tested or reviewed
- [ ] The change does not expose secrets or personal data
